overview: Coral islands with turquoise lagoons, overwater villas and house reefs right off the beach. Pick a family-friendly resort with a kids' club and shallow lagoon, or a guesthouse island for value.
fit: Shallow lagoons make it easy for the 4-year-old; the 10-year-old can snorkel. Overwater villas need close watching.
season: December to April is dry and calm (28–31°C). May–November is wetter with some rough days, but prices drop.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Malé (direct or via Colombo/Bengaluru)
Speedboat or seaplane to the resort

gettingAround: Resort transfers only; islands are tiny and walkable.

todo.title: Lagoon swimming and house reef snorkelling
todo.why: Fish and turtles from the beach

stay.why: Next to the airport, for a night before/after

foodTips: Pick a resort with Indian chefs or buffets if the kids are fussy.
save: Speedboat-transfer resorts are far cheaper than seaplane ones
Split nights between a local island and a resort
Travel in late April or November for lower rates
safety: Kids in life vests near overwater decks
Medical care is limited on resorts
kids: Choose beach villas, not overwater, with the 4-year-old
Check that the resort has a kids' club and baby pool

days.plan: Fly to Malé; transfer to resort

visa: Free 30-day tourist visa on arrival for all nationalities with a confirmed hotel booking and return ticket. Fill in the IMUGA traveller declaration online within 96 hours before arrival.
